Aleph Skill **v2.10.0** hardens the numerical simulation engine, execution trace contract, schema repair tools, and turn-key pipeline orchestrator based on findings from dual-isolated (zero-Internet and zero-post-cutoff recall) empirical evaluation runs.

## Highlights

- **Gated Execution Trace & Replay Fix (P0).** Resolves the `UNKNOWN_FIELD` deadlock on `"gate_multiplier"` in `scripts/aleph/trace_contract.py` so models with conditional edge `gate` rules pass `validate_execution_trace_data`, `replay_simulation.py`, `score_butterfly.py`, `render_simulation_report.py`, `finalize_simulation.py --complete`, and `validate_simulation_artifacts.py --mode final --require-report` end-to-end. Also fixes `stochastic_shocks` and `model_id` propagation in `scripts/replay_simulation.py` and `computational_model.model_hash` verification in `scripts/aleph/validator.py`.
- **Safe Trace Regeneration & Horizon Control (`scripts/run_simulation.py`).** Preserves default tamper/stale-trace guards (`PARAMETERS_HASH_MISMATCH`, `TRACE_EMPTY`) while adding opt-in `--regenerate-trace` (`--overwrite-trace`), `--sync-manifest-mode`, and `--forecast-steps <H>` (`ticks = H + 1`, explicitly keeping tick `0` at cutoff equilibrium).
- **Per-Tick Monte Carlo Uncertainty Fan Charts (`trajectory_quantiles`).** In Formula `2.2.0`, `run_monte_carlo` expands `summary.quantiles` to `p05`, `p10`, `p50`, `p90`, and `p95` and emits per-tick `summary.trajectory_quantiles[tick][var]`, summarized in generated `REPORT.md` tables while keeping legacy `2.0.0`/`2.1.0` hashes bit-identical.
- **Endogenous State-Dependent Tail Shocks.** Extends `stochastic_shocks` in `schemas/simulation-manifest.schema.json`, `scripts/aleph/engine.py`, and `scripts/aleph/validator.py` with optional conditional `"gate"` and `"hazard_driver"` (`{"node", "threshold", "slope", "max_probability"}`) triggers evaluated against prior-tick state while keeping static shock RNG paths bit-identical.
- **Duration, Intervention & Legacy Replay Semantics.** Supports all valid zero-length ISO-8601 durations (`P0M`, `P0W`, `P0Y`, `PT0S`) in `parse_duration_seconds`, prevents silent `manifest.change_point` double-injection when explicit `interventions.json` entries are declared, and preserves cryptographic replay compatibility in `scripts/replay_simulation.py` for pre-`v2.10.0` workspaces recorded with legacy `change_point` stubs.
- **LLM Schema Repair & Turn-Key `--from-llm-json` Pipeline.** Hardens `scripts/repair_model_schema.py` for non-object gates, non-stock/inertia attributes, target/op aliases, value-less qualitative interventions, shock repair, `end_tick <= start_tick`, and missing exogenous target synthesis; adds `--workspace` exact-directory initialization to `scripts/init_simulation_workspace.py`; and adds `--from-llm-json`, `--forecast-steps`, and `--finalize` (with automatic branch synchronization) to `scripts/run_pipeline.py`.
- **Empirical Dual-Isolated Verification.** Verified post-upgrade across saved isolated runs: `6/6` Tier 3 agentic workspaces pass `replay` + `finalize --complete` + `validate --mode final`, `9/9` Tier 1 and `8/8` Tier 2 local-LLM outputs pass end-to-end deterministic + Monte Carlo mode-switching with per-tick `trajectory_quantiles`, and the `BLIND_B_UNCOND` endogenous hazard backtest captures the empirical energy spike inside the simulated upper tail envelope (`p90` peak `147.97`, `p95` peak `160.12`, 8 `tail_shock` clusters totaling `0.255` mass).

## Upgrade

Choose the [runtime ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.10.0/aleph-skill-runtime-v2.10.0.zip) for normal use or the [full ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.10.0/aleph-skill-v2.10.0.zip) for development and local release checks. Python 3.10+ and Node.js 18+ are supported.

Install into a fresh directory. Keep a backup of existing workspaces and preserve declared `formula_version` when reproducing legacy runs (`2.0.0`, `2.1.0`, or `2.2.0`).

```sh
python3 scripts/preflight.py --json
python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py --self-test
```

## Verify the download

Put the two ZIPs, `distribution-manifest.json`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` in one directory. Verify the listed digests and the build provenance before installing:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt  # macOS alternative: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-v2.10.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.10.0

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-runtime-v2.10.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.10.0
```

GitHub's attestation service verifies the source tag and workflow identity. The [release workflow](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/actions/workflows/release.yml) records cross-platform test checks, reproducible archive builds, and SLSA provenance.
